Vedanta Iron & Steel Share Surges Significantly in Short Period

Vedanta Iron and Steel's share price experienced a rapid increase, reportedly surging by 70% in just 11 days. The stock hit an upper circuit for the 11th consecutive day. The company, part of the Vedanta Group, was listed on June 15th. The reasons behind this significant surge are being investigated.
